blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Cambodian Deputy Prime Minister Hang Chuon Naron arrived in Manila on Saturday. These events come ahead of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits scheduled for Nov. 15 to 17. The two officials are among the foreign dignitaries arriving in the country for the three-day meetings, which will bring together Southeast Asian leaders and representatives of Asean’s dialogue partners.
